name: an overview dashboard with a big figure and a trend chart
looks: A warm glow resolves into a dark dashboard card: a huge currency figure rolls up top-left, a small percentage change beside it, a filter row of pill tabs, a spline chart drawing across the middle, and a row of four small stat columns settling beneath it.
build: data-infographic: the big figure rolls its digits up with a vertical blur during the count; the spline draws progressively with strokeDashoffset and a travelling dot; the four stat columns fade in staggered beneath, each with its own small trend arrow.
sound: A rising tone under the big number, a soft tick as the spline's dot lands, a tick per stat column.
prompt: Resolve a warm glow into a dense dashboard card: a huge headline figure rolling up top-left with a small change badge beside it, a filter tab row, a spline chart drawing across the middle with a travelling dot, and a row of small supporting stats settling beneath. Use it to show a year's financial picture arriving all at once, in order.
